goal: Bound repository discovery and tool output to needed evidence and recover only unfinished local operations, preserving required dependency closure and foreground role limits.

acceptance.assertion: Implement S6 of docs/specs/workflow-decision-closure.spec.md using existing discovery/dispatch contracts. Declare question, named scope, evidence and stop conditions; read known paths directly, expand along proven callers/owners, and stop irrelevant probes after closure. Independent local calls use allSettled-style results while dependent actions remain ordered. Handle truncation with bounded continuation and inspect successful partial edits before retrying unfinished work. Preserve task-owned-only cleanup, user changes, project-specific log scope, Host model ownership, no nested delegation, foreground roles and empty Footer. Update mirrored protocol and affected tests/scenario controls. Telemetry remains observational; no hard call/token cap may omit necessary evidence, and no cross-session efficiency claim is made without comparable measurements. No new orchestrator, parallel Managed tasks, broad session scan or weakened tests.
